- Status: completed.
- Artifacts changed: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/code-review-m2-r2.json and original-reporter finding dispositions in reviews/code-review-m2-r1.json.
- Open blockers: none for M2.
- Next stage: return to route for M2 closeout and authorized M3 implementation.
- Review status: approved.
- Material findings: no new findings; release-m2-f1/f2/f3/f4 resolved.
- Recording status: recorded upon successful primary persistence.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/code-review-m2-r2.json.
- Assessment scope: milestone.
- Reviewed milestone: M2, full slice over 3dcea08b through 4c01bd10.
- Milestone closeout: closed within this assessment; route owns progression.
- Remaining implementation milestones: M3 and M4.
- Required review-resolution: no unresolved M2 finding.
- Finding IDs: release-m2-f1 through release-m2-f4 resolved by original reporter.
- Verify readiness: not-claimed; remaining milestones, final independent whole-change review and distinct Verify remain.

## Independent exact-scope reassessment

The independent reviewer authored no implementation, tests, Design or plan. This is the same original reporter of all four findings, with fresh inspection of the complete changed executor/provider/test slice and producer/consumer interactions. The approved design-review-r4 four-member normative package and delivery-review-r1 primary plan remain unchanged. M1 code-review-m1-r3 remains the prior milestone basis. Unchanged code/provider/contract portions from the full r1 inspection retain applicability; all correction bodies and their integrated executor use were freshly inspected, not inferred from test names. Prior judgments and their original subjects remain preserved; this approval concerns the exact current subjects above.

M2 now establishes the physical provider-artifact linkage at the irreversible-operation boundary, observes rather than blindly retries uncertain writes, and preserves/report facts through Git CAS and validated local recovery. The original pending-publication validation default remains intact. The actual public-closeout, metadata, archive and timing validators are exercised with external service substitutes, not success-policy stubs. The same retained tarball remains the publish input with trusted provenance arguments and token fallback removed. Hosted composition, real setup and complete actual-candidate-to-hosted-dispatch proof remain M3; source retirement remains M4. No live publication or remote configuration was performed or authorized here.

## Validation evidence

Authoritative evidence release-m2-implementation-r2 matches the five exact M2 engineering subjects at 4c01bd10. Author commands: `python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p release_execution_tests.py` passed 24 tests in 42.456s after regression-first 3 failures/3 errors; `python scripts/test-release-transaction.py` passed 145 tests in 91.246s (/tmp/release-m2-corrected-full.log); Python compile and diff checks passed. This full entrypoint includes the retained actual candidate/archive/package/packed-install verification composition with public services substituted.

Independent reviewer command `PYTHONPATH=scripts python -m unittest release_execution_tests` passed all 24 tests in 38.541s (/tmp/release-m2-review-r2.log). A separate Python heredoc exercised actual materialize_artifact against the fixture provider ZIP and confirmed the exact resulting candidate identity; independently constructed duplicate-member and symlink ZIPs rejected through retained_artifact_files with correctly recomputed outer digest. No validator or persistence implementation was replaced. The current source identities were refreshed through primary subject inspection before recording. `node scripts/validate-record-store.mjs docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/change.json` and `git diff --check` are the scoped post-record checks; their output is reported separately from semantic approval.


The earlier failed first-pass regressions and full-suite nested-parser failure remain failed historical observations. Their correction and passing reruns establish only the named local fixture boundaries; no hosted CI/public-release success is inferred. New artifact byte binding and extraction are a bounded M2 implementation of the existing plan, not an expansion of release authority. The timing document intentionally reports missing phase diagnostics rather than claiming telemetry completeness; this is the approved nonblocking consequence, not a hidden validation pass.

## Finding dispositions

- release-m2-f1: Resolved: actual provider ZIP bytes are fetched at the immutable artifact endpoint, bounded/hash-checked against the provider digest, checked for unsafe/duplicate/inventory/member identities, and compared byte-for-byte with the local candidate before writes. A valid resealed replacement candidate under the same old artifact now rejects without publication. Physical materialization is available for M3; it expressly does not itself authorize publication.

- release-m2-f2: Resolved: write intent sets uncertain_write before dispatch; unknown first tag outcome produces uncertain-publication/failed-during-publish. Subprocess timeouts join lost-response handling and authoritative observation, with no raw private command persisted. Matching observations clear uncertainty; retries retain original authority and do not duplicate confirmed writes.

- release-m2-f3: Resolved: each emitted timing projection is assessed by the actual owning validator and its errors/warnings/result are recorded separately. Missing phases remain disclosed diagnostic failure and do not block otherwise successful publication; no unavailable durations are invented.

- release-m2-f4: Resolved: recovery reads and checks the retained observation bundle against candidate/run/attempt and durable append-only event ancestry before overwriting; old local history cannot roll back newer durable state, divergence rejects. The previously sole reporting-failure event survives successful recovery in durable history while public writes remain one per boundary. Recovered observations do not replace fresh authorization or public inspection.

## Checklist

| Item | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | pass | M2 REL-SR-10–19/22–24 and TG-03/04 satisfied within the explicit external-fixture boundary. |
| Test coverage | pass | Actual executor/CAS/owner-validator suite plus new artifact substitution, unsafe ZIP, first-write uncertainty, timeout, timing diagnostic and retained-history assertions. |
| Edge cases | pass | Duplicate/competing attempts, partial GitHub assets, unknown public state, failed smoke, retained reporting failure and no duplicate writes directly covered. |
| Error handling | pass | Unknown result is preserved, public facts reobserved, persistence failure remains incomplete, recovery ancestry checked before overwrite. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | Concrete provider artifact download connects authorization to bytes; existing metadata/closeout/timing owners remain authoritative. |
| Compatibility | pass | Pending validation default and unchanged legacy workflow retained until M3; no old release/history files removed. |
| Security/privacy | pass | Safe member names/digests/inventory, immutable local binding, OIDC retained tarball, no token fallback, bounded timeout/error reporting. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass | Source/tool/configuration and retained candidate checks; archive/public tree identity; generated public metadata and diagnostic disclosures. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | M2 implementation and proof only; no hosted activation, remote configuration or retirement. |
| Validation evidence | pass | Exact current local suite results, direct independent executor rerun, scoped store/diff checks and limits stated. |

## Handoff

M2 can close under this milestone assessment and route may continue to the already authorized M3. No engineering, activity or work mutation is made by the reviewer. M3 must consume the tested materialization/authorization boundary and prove the real complete candidate and workflow composition, including retained observations across hosted failure/recovery. M4 and final whole-change assessment/Verify remain; this is not PR readiness.
independence_basis: Independent original reporter authored no engineering and freshly reassessed complete M2 corrections, unchanged interaction basis and actual validation on exact subjects.
